page.notes: The woodcut shows a bearded figure with a crown and sceptre, seated astride a large eagle, with spread wings. No printed text is in it. The "M" of the date is written with a reversed-C style flourish, rendered here as "M." Some letters in the title are set in long-s-free roman; "Ecclesiasticæ" and "Stu-diosis" are printed as shown. Small stains on the page are not transcribed.
